name: 94596 · Walnut Creek, CA
findings: ZIP 94596 (Walnut Creek) has 198 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94596 (Walnut Creek) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94596 (Walnut Creek) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
